title: Message claiming a hack appears on Haiti's judicial police (DCPJ) website, Haitian Times reports
date_note: The Haitian Times page, published 26 November, says the message appeared on Thursday (26 November).
org: Direction centrale de la police judiciaire (DCPJ)
geo_basis: Haiti's national police agency; the Haitian Times names no city, so the pin is the capital
summary: The Haitian Times reports that a message claiming Haiti's judicial police website had been hacked appeared on its homepage on Thursday. Wanted-person notices and news updates later failed to load before the site was restored that evening, the paper says. It says it is unclear who posted the message, whether it was connected to the disruption, or whether anyone accessed police records.
plain: A Haitian newspaper reports that a message claiming a hack appeared on the judicial police website. The site was later restored. It is unclear who posted it or whether any records were accessed.
exec: A national police website showed a hack claim; the Haitian Times says it is unclear whether records were accessed.

validation.note: Only the Haitian Times; it quotes no statement from the DCPJ or the national police.

review.note: tag: removed hacktivism; Haitian Times says who posted the message is unclear (stronger than source). Rest matches page.
